senses.gloss:
वृथा ind. [वृ-थाल् किच्च]
1 To no
purpose, in vain, uselessly,
unprofitably; often with the force an
adjective; व्यर्थं यत्र कपींद्रसख्यमपि मे
वीर्यं हरीणां वृथा U. 3. 45; दिवं यदि
प्रार्थयसे वृथा श्रमः Ku. 5. 45.
--2
Unnecessarily.
--3 Foolishly, idly,
wantonly.
--4 Wrongly; improperly.
(At the beginning of comp. वृथा
may be translated by ‘vain, useless,
improper, false, idle’ &c.).
--Comp.
--अक्ष्या strolling about idly,
walking for pleasure.
--आकारः a false
form, an empty show.
--कथा idle
talk.
--जन्मन् n. unprofitable or vain
birth.
--दानं a gift that may be
revoked, or not made good if
promised.
--मति a. foolish-minded.
--मांसं
flesh not intended for the Gods or
Manes.
--वादिन् a. speaking falsely.
